title: cimicifuga simplex var. typica
intro: Cimicifuga simplex var. typica, commonly known as Black Cohosh, is a perennial plant native to Eastern North America, belonging to the family Ranunculaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to alleviate symptoms of menopause, such as hot flashes and night sweats, due to its health benefits in reducing hormonal imbalances and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Black Cohosh include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and estrogen-modulating properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as triterpene glycosides, including cimicifugoside and acteoside, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
